milestone.describes: A race is driven end to end and the results screen reports distance, score and a new mission.

steps.expect: Title menu: REDLINE over a green field, with the HUD strip along the top.
Car select, with a car, its star rating and an UNLOCKED panel.
The controls card: LEFT / RIGHT / SLOW TIME and the legend.
A race in progress: the car on the voxel track with the distance, score and fuel HUD live. Leaving it longer ends at RESULT, showing DISTANCE, SCORE and NEW MISSION.

notes: Press duration matters: about 300 ms. A 90 ms press is not seen at all, and that produces a convincing false negative because the title screen animates on its own for a few seconds after load, so a frame comparison right after a missed tap still shows a change. Confirm the screen is static first, then tap.

This app used to carry --landscape-native. That was a workaround for a presentation bug, not a fact about the app; with the bug fixed it needs the ordinary rotation. If a replay shows the frame rotated a quarter turn and stretched, check the launch options before anything else.

The race drives itself far enough to reach a result without steering input, which is why no steering steps are recorded. Steering is on-screen left/right; tilt does not work because Core Motion is a no-op.
